name: Whirl imp
description: a small wiry hell imp of the Ember Wastes: crimson leathery skin, short curled black horns, leathery bat wings, a long whip tail with a spade tip, yellow eyes and a toothy grin, its skin a hot pink-red, both arms held straight out to the sides spitting thin trails of embers, dizzy grin, wings blurred

poses.stand: hovering mid-twirl with both arms stretched out to the sides, tail curled round it, a little dizzy
poses.struck: just hit and recoiling, eyes wide, mouth open, body jolted back, sparks and chips flying off it
poses.dead: breaking apart in a burst of black soot, grey ash and orange embers

idle.action: hovers, swaying a little dizzily, arms out, wings beating

attack.action: spins round and round in place in the air like a top, arms out, spitting two spiral arms of embers, then wobbles to a stop

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a pained grimace, then recovers

die.action: flares bright and breaks apart into soot, ash and embers
